args.sql: SELECT interact_fan_pivot, COUNT(*) as activity_count FROM interactions WHERE interact_fan_pivot IS NOT NULL GROUP BY interact_fan_pivot ORDER BY activity_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    f.nick_label,
    (sc.content_creation->>'UGC_Val')::int as ugc_val,
    (sc.network_stats->>'Foll_Count')::int as foll_count,
    (sc.network_stats->>'Soc_Net_Sz')::int as soc_net_sz,
    SQRT((sc.network_stats->>'Foll_Count')::numeric * (sc.network_stats->>'Soc_Net_Sz')::numeric) as cii
FROM fans f
JOIN membershipandspending ms ON f.user_registry = ms.member_fan_pivot
JOIN engagement e ON ms.member_reg = e.engage_member_pivot
JOIN socialcommunity sc ON e.engage_reg = sc.social_engage_pivot
LIMIT 10;
SELECT events_member_pivot, COUNT(*) as event_count FROM eventsandclub GROUP BY events_member_pivot ORDER BY event_count DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT engagement.engage_reg, engagement.act_days_wk, socialcommunity.social_reg FROM engagement JOIN socialcommunity ON engagement.engage_reg = socialcommunity.social_engage_pivot LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    f.nick_label,
    (sc.content_creation->>'UGC_Val')::int as ugc_val,
